messages.subject: Re: from shiny8 to shiny9: Error in substitute(value)[[2]] : subscript out of bounds
parts:
Hi Yihui, I have found the problem. 

This app works fine :

runApp(
  list(
    ui=pageWithSidebar(
      headerPanel(""),
      sidebarPanel(
        downloadButton("dwn","download")
      ),
      mainPanel()
      ),
    server=function(input,output,session){
      output$dwn <- downloadHandler(
        filename = function() {
          "hello.txt"
        },
        content = function(file) {
          write.table(x="hello", file=file)
        }
      )
    })
  )

But with the previous version of shiny, the following equivalent app worked fine too, but it doesn't work with the current version :

fdownload <- function(){
  downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {
      "hello.txt"
    },
    content = function(file) {
      write.table(x="hello", file=file)
    }
  )
}

runApp(
  list(
    ui=pageWithSidebar(
      headerPanel(""),
      sidebarPanel(
        downloadButton("dwn","download")
      ),
      mainPanel()
    ),
    server=function(input,output,session){
      output$dwn <- fdownload()
    })
)

messages.author: 5893d17d64b5b0c2
messages.subject: Re: from shiny8 to shiny9: Error in substitute(value)[[2]] : subscript out of bounds
parts:
Mea culpa, I broke this--the problem arises from an attempt to get source references for an output, and occurs generally when an output is assigned to a function that takes no arguments (i.e. output$dwn <- fdownload() below(). I'll have a fix for review shortly. 

Jonathan.

messages.subject: Re: from shiny8 to shiny9: Error in substitute(value)[[2]] : subscript out of bounds
parts:
Hi Jonathan, 

My colleagues and I are using shiny to generate an app to make our own R package more user-friendly, but it has now run up against this error (Error in substitute(value)[[2]] : subscript out of bounds) in the new version. I can alter our code to work in spite of this error and release a new version of our package, but if you think you are likely to release a new version of shiny that overcomes the error in question in the next couple of days, that would seem to be poor practice on my part. 

Would you be able to give us an estimate on when we can expect a new version of shiny to come out? 

Thanks in advance. And keep up the great work on shiny (it's excellent)! 

Cheers, 
Caitlin.
